description:
FILED s473t1 (Opus, the 13-file early-stop triage).  PRE-EXISTING.

perl-tests/method.t:589-591

    sub IO::Handle::self { $_[0] }
    is *stdout2->self, (\*stdout2)->self,
       '*glob->method is equiv to (\*glob)->method';

PCL: the top-level form aborts with

    ; PCL recovery: top-level form aborted (recovered):
      Can't call method self on unblessed reference

so the row is never produced (method.t 124/163; this is 1 of its 37 missing
assertions).  perl produces it and it passes: a typeglob and a ref to one both
dispatch as IO handles.

The two rows either side of it (`method call on typeglob ignores package`,
`$pvlv_glob->method`) are already blessed FAILS in
baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, so the family is known; this spelling is the one
that DIES instead of answering.
subject: `*glob->method` and `(\*glob)->method` die "Can't call method self on unblessed reference" -- perl dispatches both through the IO::Handle class
